# Star-Office-UI vendor assets

Source repository: https://github.com/ringhyacinth/Star-Office-UI
Pinned source commit: `f29c107e9728a72f2635f10b4e8203b29b37221d`

## Tracked background and furniture

- `office_bg.webp` — `frontend/office_bg.webp`
- `desk-v3.webp` — `frontend/desk-v3.webp`
- `sofa-idle-v3.png` — `frontend/sofa-idle-v3.png`

The upstream `LICENSE` separates MIT code/logic from art assets. The art assets in this repository are for non-commercial learning, demonstration, and idea sharing only. These three files are included for the local Section9 non-commercial demo; preserve this notice and do not use them for commercial distribution without compatible permission.

## Local-only guest sprites

`guest_anim_1.webp` through `guest_anim_4.webp` are retained as local files for the demo but are gitignored and must not be added to a public source distribution. Star-Office-UI attributes them to LimeZu's Animated Mini Characters 2 (Platformer) [FREE]:

https://limezu.itch.io/animated-mini-characters-2-platform-free

LimeZu's official page permits use in free and commercial projects and modification, but says the asset pack may not be redistributed or resold. Fetch these files locally with the repository's pinned fetch script; do not commit or re-host the raw sprite sheets.
